title: Friend groups
description:
Find groups of friends with union-find.

```
friends: ada-bob, cy-dee, bob-eve, fay-fay
groups: [ada bob eve] [cy dee] [fay] [gus]
are ada and eve connected? yes
```
hints: Path compression: `if (m_parent[x] != x) m_parent[x] = find(m_parent[x]); return m_parent[x];` (lesson 4.05).
requirements: `class DisjointSets(n)` with `find` (with path compression) and `unite` (by size).
Map names to indexes with a `std::unordered_map`.
Print the groups with their members sorted.
stretch: Count how many friendships it takes until everyone is in one group.
